audit_type: Read-only static source review; no model load, GPU use, installs, or downloaded source execution

pins.base_safetensors_api_parameters_note: Includes vision; AutoModelForCausalLM builds the text-only model. Not an observed loaded parameter count.

prompt_contract.style: auto resolves to chat when tokenizer has chat_template
prompt_contract.structure: system instructions; user State delimited by <<<STATE / STATE>>>; typed Question; Options as bare label + period + option text; instruction to answer one label
prompt_contract.ending: generation prompt or plain Answer:\n; ensure final newline
prompt_contract.untrusted_text: neutralize added/special token strings with zero-width-space after first character
prompt_contract.truncation: budget state after fixed prompt with eight-token slack; clip option text to 60 characters only if fixed prompt leaves no state room; raise if still too long
prompt_contract.binary_canonical_orientation: Caller must define orientation. Paper binary examples use A=True and B=False. Do not confuse displayed permutation with canonical target order.
prompt_contract.padding: left; last attention-mask column must be all ones

readout_and_loss.readout: model(input_ids, attention_mask, logits_to_keep=1, use_cache=False); out.logits[:, -1, :].float(); gather label_token_ids
readout_and_loss.normalization: softmax only across valid option slots, computed FP32
readout_and_loss.weights_note: Weighted mean does not divide by sum of weights. For verified hard SkillRet gold, unit weight is the clear starting point.
readout_and_loss.calibration_caveat: Original-domain release temperature is not validation-fitted SkillRet calibration. Keep before/after evaluation settings identical.

adapter.continue_method: PeftModel.from_pretrained(base_model, adapter_directory, is_trainable=True); official load_lora_for_training calls enable_input_require_grads when checkpointing is on
adapter.avoid: get_peft_model fresh initialization and merge_and_unload for continued adapter training

installed_transformers_audit.fallback_gate: Set USE_HUB_KERNELS=NO before imports. hub_kernels reads it once. Local fla and causal_conv1d imports are attempted independently of that flag; verify both absent before model import.
installed_transformers_audit.hub_disabled_assertion: import transformers.integrations.hub_kernels as hk; assert hk._TRANSFORMERS_USE_HUB_KERNELS == 'NO' and hk._kernels_enabled is False
installed_transformers_audit.static_package_search: No fla or causal_conv1d package directories found under overlay or mia5150-local/.venv/lib with bounded find; runtime find_spec remains required.
installed_transformers_audit.fallback_compute: PyTorch F.conv1d, FP32 Q/K/V/beta/decay conversions, default chunk size 64, torch.linalg.solve_triangular, sequential loop across chunks
installed_transformers_audit.mixed_precision_caveat: Outer autocast can still affect inner eligible matmuls despite explicit FP32 inputs; backward/finite behavior on SM75 must be measured.
installed_transformers_audit.text_model: AutoModelForCausalLM maps qwen3_5 to Qwen3_5ForCausalLM, auto_factory extracts text_config, conversion mapping removes language_model prefix; class ignores visual and mtp unexpected keys
installed_transformers_audit.avoid_full_multimodal: Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration instantiates the vision model, unnecessary for binary text relevance
installed_transformers_audit.load_memory: from_pretrained initializes model on meta and uses mmap plus safetensors get_slice lazily in Linux; do not disable mmap or materialize full checkpoint in Python
installed_transformers_audit.device_map: Single-GPU explicit map can avoid a full CPU-resident model. Loader warms CUDA allocator using approximately model tensor bytes, capped at total device memory minus 1.2 GiB; guard transient memory anyway.

stock_pipeline_risks: training_arguments wires bf16 but no fp16 argument; changing weight dtype alone is not an AMP/GradScaler training implementation
Saved run report_to is wandb; disable telemetry explicitly
Saved per-device train batch22, 2048 max tokens, 8 data workers and 16GB free-GPU selection gate are inappropriate here
Requirements include flash-linear-attention and tilelang; do not install or execute unknown optimized kernels for this pilot
remaining_empirical_checks: Runtime package absence, pinned safetensors hashes, exact loaded class and adapter key compatibility
Two optimizer updates: finite forward/loss/gradients; adapter changes; frozen base unchanged; save/reload equivalence
Observed memory, swap, CPU, temperature and time under training guard
Matched baseline/adapted SkillRet quality with exposure-aware split labeling
